$comment: Bundled print colour profiles. Single source for `pnpm icc:sync` (tools/scripts/icc-sync.ts), the API profile list (crates/oc-api, print_profiles.rs) and the colour engine (crates/oc-color, include_str!). ECI profiles are freely redistributable (https://www.eci.org); the compact sRGB v4 profile is CC0 (saucecontrol/Compact-ICC-Profiles) and lives in crates/oc-color/icc/.

profiles.name: PSO Coated v3
profiles.condition: Offset printing according to ISO 12647-2:2013, paper type PS1 (premium coated), FOGRA51
profiles.description: Offset, premium coated paper (ISO 12647-2:2013). The usual choice for European commercial print.

profiles.name: PSO Uncoated v3
profiles.condition: Offset printing according to ISO 12647-2:2013, paper type PS5 (wood-free uncoated), FOGRA52
profiles.description: Offset, uncoated paper (ISO 12647-2:2013). Letterheads, notebooks, natural paper stocks.

profiles.name: ISO Coated v2 (ECI)
profiles.condition: Offset printing according to ISO 12647-2:2004/Amd 1, paper type 1 or 2 (coated art), FOGRA39
profiles.description: Offset, coated paper (ISO 12647-2:2004). Still requested by many printers.

profiles.name: sRGB IEC61966-2.1
profiles.description: Screens and RGB print workflows (digital presses, photo labs).
